This is a staff-advancement manual on the Ramathibodi academic site. Title, author, unit and year (2567) come from search-result text, and the title is also in the file name. The landing_url is the directory, not an HTML landing page: I found no dedicated landing page. HEAD returns 200 application/pdf. It is written by an individual nurse for promotion, so authority is institutional but not a guideline. Not in the existing corpus.
